_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: Opening a chat clears its bold title across browsers and keeps the open row quiet. The server runs in workspace mode, with the conversation {{CONV_ID}}. Call "reply" sends it a message its agent answers; call "another" starts another conversation, {{OTHER}}, and waits for its reply. The page's first read receipt for {{CONV_ID}} (a request to /api/conversation/{{CONV_ID}}/read) is held at the server until call "release"; call "read requested" says whether it has arrived ("true" or "false"). Besides the main tab there is a second browser window, the tab named "observer", a desktop: steps say which tab they act on, and the rest act on the main tab. "The row" is "[data-conversation-id=\"{{CONV_ID}}\"]" and "the bold row" is ".conversation-item-unread[data-conversation-id=\"{{CONV_ID}}\"]". Perform the steps in order. 1. Open the observer tab by navigating it to /new. 2. Set the observer tab's viewport to width 1280, height 900, scale 1, not mobile, no touch. 3. Navigate the observer tab to /new again, so it loads as a desktop. 4. In the observer tab, the row should be visible. 5. Set the main tab's viewport to width 1280, height 900 (only width and height). 6. Navigate the main tab to /new. 7. In the main tab, the row should be visible. 8. Call "reply". 9. In the observer tab, the bold row should become visible. 10. In the main tab, the bold row should become visible. 11. In the main tab, click the row. 12. Call "read requested" until it returns "true" (the receipt is now held). 13. In the main tab, the row should have aria-current "page". 14. In the main tab, there should be exactly 0 bold rows. 15. In the observer tab, the bold row should still be visible. 16. Call "release". 17. In the observer tab, there should come to be exactly 0 bold rows. 18. Call "another". 19. Reload the observer tab by navigating it to /new. 20. In the observer tab, ".conversation-item-unread[data-conversation-id=\"{{OTHER}}\"]" should be visible. 21. In the observer tab, the row should be visible. 22. In the observer tab, there must be exactly 0 bold rows.
